name: PingPong sampler with FBG (MD)
plain: x0-renoise loop with an ancestral window, choice of blend functions for each move, optional restarts and feedback guidance using a log-posterior estimate. Core imports a compiled binary first.
math: Non-ancestral: x=bf(x0,x,σ′/σ). Ancestral: n; RF: x=bf(x0,n,σ′); else x=x0+nσ′. Options: noise norm clamp, conditional blend by sigma or change ratio, restarts. FBG scale from EMA of log posterior.
label: from code
surprise: The node first imports pingpong_sampler_core_bin, a compiled module, preferring it over the source file.
